newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ascom says Q1 orders up, sees good 1997.
newsitem.headline: Ascom says Q1 orders up, sees good 1997.

text.p: Swiss telecommunications group Ascom Holding AG on Wednesday reported a 1996 net group loss of 128 million Swiss francs ($87.3 million) but said orders in the first quarter were clearly higher than a year ago.
It said sales were slightly lower in the period but forecast a satisfactory full year in 1997.
"Incoming orders in the first quarter of 1997 were clearly higher than the corresponding year-ago quarter, while sales were slightly lower," an Ascom statement said.
"Ascom expects business to go satisfactorily in 1997," it added without elaborating.
